Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
>> iii. Any Methuselah may immediately call a Blood Hunt vote to burn
the
>> Diabolist. A successful vote means the Acting Vampire is
burned.
>> This is not an Action and may not be Blocked. (20.2) [SAB]
>> NOTE: Only one Bloodhunt vote may be called on each
Diablerie. [RTR]
>> ! NOTE: Only Meths with Camarilla vamps can call a Blood Hunt.
[JON]

^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
^^^^^

What!?!?!
This _*cannot*_ be right!
That means that any meth that controls Giovanni, Ravnos, Assamites or
Setites cannot call a Bloodhunt?
This is so wrong. That means they can essentially get their vamps
diablorized for free (If the other meths
don't care to call the Bloodhunt).
Camarilla can call a Bloodhunt and Sabbat a Wildhunt. What recourse do the
independants have?

Sorrow
